messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or create a three‑day weekend) in Canada for 2023.  (Note that some provinces/territories have additional holidays that may also create a long weekend, but the following are the nationwide or widely observed ones.)

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (Observed) | In 2023, the holiday is observed on Monday, Jan 2, creating a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | Creates a long weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day (all provinces except Quebec) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **May 22** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia, Yukon) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day (observed on Monday, July 3 in some provinces) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday, Nov 7 in most provinces) | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Creates a long weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |

### Provincial/Territorial Variations

| Province/Territory | Additional Long Weekend Holidays in 2023 |
|--------------------|------------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day (Feb 20), National Indigenous Peoples Day (May 22) |
| **Manitoba** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **New Brunswick** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Nova Scotia** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Quebec** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Northwest Territories** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Nunavut** | None beyond the national holidays listed above |
| **Yukon** | National Indigenous Peoples Day (May 22) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Use the `datetime` module to calculate the day of the week for each holiday.  
> - For holidays that are observed on a different day (e.g., New Year’s Day observed on Monday, Jan 2), make sure to include both the actual date and the observed date.  
> - If you want to support province‑specific holidays, consider storing a mapping of provinces to their unique holidays and checking the user’s location.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need additional provincial holidays!
